niit.allocable_state_income_tax.label: Allocable state income tax
niit.allocable_state_income_tax.help: Only the actual itemized income tax allocated to investment income. Property taxes and amounts excluded by the SALT limit are not included.

amt.iso_adjustment.label: Iso adjustment
amt.iso_adjustment.help: Verified regular-vs-AMT difference from source records; do not enter gross exercise proceeds or an unsupported basis guess.

amt.other_adjustments.label: Other adjustments
amt.other_adjustments.help: Verified regular-vs-AMT difference from source records; do not enter gross exercise proceeds or an unsupported basis guess.

amt.capital_gain_adjustment.label: Capital gain adjustment
amt.capital_gain_adjustment.help: Verified regular-vs-AMT difference from source records; do not enter gross exercise proceeds or an unsupported basis guess.

rentals.*.depreciation.label: Depreciation
rentals.*.depreciation.help: Deductible amount from the verified asset depreciation schedule; new-asset Form4562 computation is not performed here.

rentals.*.no_personal_use_or_substantial.label: No personal use or substantial services

dependents.*.eitc_status_reviewed.help: EITC child residency/tiebreaker tests differ from child-tax-credit tests.

dependents.*.eitc_relationship_residency.help: EITC child residency/tiebreaker tests differ from child-tax-credit tests.

dependents.*.eitc_full_time_student.label: Eitc full time student
dependents.*.eitc_full_time_student.help: EITC child residency/tiebreaker tests differ from child-tax-credit tests.

marketplace.region.label: Federal poverty-line region
marketplace.region.help: Use2024FPL for2025coverage; select higherAlaska/Hawaii table when required by a move or spouses in different states.

marketplace.below_poverty_exception.label: Income below100%FPL exception
marketplace.below_poverty_exception.help: Estimated-income exception needs Marketplace estimate at least100%, APTC in a month, no intentional/reckless misstatement and all other eligibility. Immigrant exception needs lawful presence and Medicaid ineligibility due to immigration status.

education.students.*.credit.label: Credit for this student
education.students.*.credit.help: One credit perstudent; AOTC needs first4years, half-time degree program, fewer than4 prior claims and no felony drug conviction. LLC books qualify only when required institution payment.

hsa.accounts.*.coverage.*.label: First-day eligible coverage
hsa.accounts.*.coverage.*.help: none includes Medicare, disqualifying coverage/FSA, dependency or otherwise ineligible; confirm eligibility before marking self/family.

hsa.spouse_coverage.*.label: Spouse first-day coverage even without an HSA

hsa.family_allocation_taxpayer_percent.label: Agreed family limit allocated to taxpayer
hsa.family_allocation_taxpayer_percent.help: The base8550 family limit is shared; the other spouse gets the remainder. Each55+ catch-up stays with its own account.

ira.contributions_and_coverage_confirmed.label: 2025contributions/timing and both employer coverage statuses verified
ira.contributions_and_coverage_confirmed.help: Exclude rollover, prior-year contribution and plan deferrals; coverage includes employer/self-employed SEP,SIMPLE,qualified plans and W2Box13 retirement-plan status.

ira.compensation_and_magi_confirmed.label: IRA compensation and modified AGI verified
ira.compensation_and_magi_confirmed.help: Compensation excludes nonqualified deferred pay, uses SE profit less SEhalf/qualified-plan deductions, and does not net a business loss against wages. MAGI is beforeIRA deduction with student-loan and statutory addbacks.

hsa.accounts.*.first_day_coverage_and_el.label: Monthly HSA eligibility and tax-year contribution amounts verified
hsa.accounts.*.first_day_coverage_and_el.help: QualifyingHDHP, no disqualifyingFSA/coverage, no Medicare or dependency on firstday of each marked eligiblemonth. Employer/Cafeteria contributions use2025 amounts, not blindly allW2CodeW if other-year contributions exist.

hsa.accounts.*.distribution_breakdown_co.label: 1099-SA distribution breakdown verified
hsa.accounts.*.distribution_breakdown_co.help: Gross includes rollovers and timely excess corrections; identify their separate amounts. Qualified rollovers need60-day/once-per-year rules. Excess-withdrawal amounts include earnings.

hsa.accounts.*.exception_taxable_distrib.label: Taxable distributions exempt from20% additional tax
hsa.accounts.*.exception_taxable_distrib.help: Enter only dollars distributed after65thbirthday, qualifying disability or death. These dollars remain taxable income. Zero means noexception; age65atyearend alone doesnot establish timing.

hsa.accounts.*.distribution_timing_confi.label: Age65 distribution dates and prebirthday portion verified

hsa.accounts.*.distribution_exception_co.label: Entered20%exception amount and supporting dates/status verified

hsa.accounts.*.year_end_balance_confirme.label: HSA year-end value including2025contributions made in2026 verified
hsa.accounts.*.year_end_balance_confirme.help: Required for the6%tax on current excess; an unverified defaultzero cannot eliminate the tax.

hsa.accounts.*.personal_contributions.label: Nonpayroll personal2025 HSA contributions
hsa.accounts.*.personal_contributions.help: Exclude employer contributions and salary reduction through a cafeteria plan; those belong in employer_contributions/W2CodeW. Also exclude trustee transfers and rollovers.

hsa.accounts.*.excess_withdrawal_distrib.label: 1099-SA gross portion from timely excess correction
hsa.accounts.*.excess_withdrawal_distrib.help: Include both withdrawn principal and related earnings only when already in the entered gross distributions. The earnings are separately reported as income in the withdrawal year.

education.claimant_refundability_facts_c.label: Under24 claimant refund facts verified
education.claimant_refundability_facts_c.help: Use the return claimant’s age/full-time status/earned income/total support/parent alive facts, not the dependent college student’s age. A parent age40 may receive a refundable credit for a student age20.

education.students.*.qualified_expenses_.label: Qualified expenses and no double benefit verified
education.students.*.qualified_expenses_.help: Exclude room/board, insurance, transportation and personal expenses; subtract tax-free grants/aid and amounts used for529/Coverdell/other deductions. Payment is in2025 for2025or first3months2026academic period.

marketplace.coverage_and_slcsp_inputs_co.label: Monthly1095-A amounts and correct applicable SLCSP verified
marketplace.coverage_and_slcsp_inputs_co.help: Do not add duplicateSLCSP amounts from same-state policies for the same coveragefamily. Correct missing/wrong benchmarks with Marketplace records; record zero months explicitly.

marketplace.tax_family_and_household_inc.label: Tax family and household MAGI verified
marketplace.tax_family_and_household_inc.help: Include claimed dependents only when required to file for income, plus their MAGI, tax-exempt interest, nontaxableSocialSecurity and foreignexcluded-income addbacks.

marketplace.dependents_magi.label: Required-filer dependents combined MAGI
marketplace.dependents_magi.help: This signed amount already includes the dependents own MAGI addbacks. Do not include a dependent who files only to recover withheld tax and was not required to file.

marketplace.annual_calculation_eligible_.label: Annual8962line11 eligibility verified
marketplace.annual_calculation_eligible_.help: All12months, unchanged premiums and correctSLCSP for each policy, no shared allocation or alternative marriage calculation. If this applies selectannual_calculation; otherwise usemonthly.

care.provider_information_confirmed.label: Provider information confirmed
care.provider_information_confirmed.help: VerifiedW10/provider name, address and TIN; no spouse/childparent/dependent/ineligibleunder19provider. Householdemployees require ScheduleH, presently blocked.

care.benefits_expenses_incurred.label: Benefits expenses incurred
care.benefits_expenses_incurred.help: PartIII expenses incurred in2025 used for employee benefit exclusion; may differ from credit expenses incurred AND paid in2025.

care.deemed_income_eligibility_confirmed.label: Deemed income eligibility confirmed
care.deemed_income_eligibility_confirmed.help: Use12 verified monthly earned-income records; each student qualifies under full-time5calendar-month rule or is incapable of self-care. Only one spouse may receive250/500deemed income in the same month.

saver.distribution_window_and_exclusions.label: Distribution window and exclusions confirmed
saver.distribution_window_and_exclusions.help: Eligible distributions after2022 through2025return due date includingextensions; exclude permittedrollovers/conversions/excesscorrections/inheritednonspousalIRA and other formalexceptions.

saver.all_distribution_years_joint.label: All distribution years joint
saver.all_distribution_years_joint.help: MFJ combines both spouses’ eligible distributions into BOTH columns. If a distribution-year return was notjoint, this simplified pooling is blocked.

elderly_credit.taxpayer_after_minimum_re.label: Taxpayer after minimum retirement age confirmed
elderly_credit.taxpayer_after_minimum_re.help: Only disability pension AFTER employerMINIMUM retirementage goes in regularpension5b and is notEIC/Care earned income. It must still meet ScheduleR preMANDATORY retirementage conditions.

elderly_credit.spouse_after_minimum_reti.label: Spouse after minimum retirement age confirmed
elderly_credit.spouse_after_minimum_reti.help: Only disability pension AFTER employerMINIMUM retirementage goes in regularpension5b and is notEIC/Care earned income. It must still meet ScheduleR preMANDATORY retirementage conditions.

elderly_credit.disability_income_in_retu.label: Disability income in return confirmed
elderly_credit.disability_income_in_retu.help: ScheduleR qualifying disability income received before employer MANDATORY retirementage. This is separate from MINIMUM retirementage determining1040line1h versus5b.

elderly_credit.other_nontaxable_pensions.label: Other nontaxable pensions
elderly_credit.other_nontaxable_pensions.help: ScheduleR13b statutory exclusions; exclude pensionbasis return, militarydisability and listedForeignService exclusions. NontaxableSocialSecurity is supplied automatically.

care.beneficiaries.*.qualified_expenses.label: Qualified expenses
care.beneficiaries.*.qualified_expenses.help: Gross qualified care incurred AND paid in2025, including amounts paid withFSA benefits. The engine subtracts excluded benefits once; do not subtract them before entry.

w2.*.dependent_care_benefits.label: Box10 dependent-care benefits
w2.*.dependent_care_benefits.help: Actual employeeBox10 benefits not already inBox1 wages; enableCare to compute excluded/taxable benefits.

retirement.disability_taxpayer_gross.label: Taxpayer disability1099-R gross
retirement.disability_taxpayer_gross.help: Separate from regularpension inputs. Employer disability pension before minimumretirementage is1040line1h; retain1099-R and eligibility/basis records.

retirement.disability_taxpayer_taxable.label: Taxpayer disability1099-R taxable
retirement.disability_taxpayer_taxable.help: Separate from regularpension inputs. Employer disability pension before minimumretirementage is1040line1h; retain1099-R and eligibility/basis records.

retirement.disability_spouse_gross.label: Spouse disability1099-R gross
retirement.disability_spouse_gross.help: Separate from regularpension inputs. Employer disability pension before minimumretirementage is1040line1h; retain1099-R and eligibility/basis records.

retirement.disability_spouse_taxable.label: Spouse disability1099-R taxable
retirement.disability_spouse_taxable.help: Separate from regularpension inputs. Employer disability pension before minimumretirementage is1040line1h; retain1099-R and eligibility/basis records.

retirement.disability_before_minimum_ret.label: Before employer minimumretirementage verified
retirement.disability_before_minimum_ret.help: Only payments received before the actual employer-set minimumretirementdate. Split later pension amounts into regularpension fields.

retirement.disability_amounts_confirmed.label: Disability1099-R amounts and no doublecount verified

itemized.force_itemized.label: Elect itemized deductions even when smaller
itemized.force_itemized.help: AMT can make a smaller ScheduleA deduction beneficial. Review both choices; automatic regular-tax deduction selection does not optimize the combined AMT liability.
